work.abstract_text: We prove Shannon's three conjectured circle-vertex formulas in OEIS A374338, FORMULA (revision 4, 5 July 2024; retained in revision 21), by identifying circle intersections with two-neighbor growth on the triangular lattice. The vertex count after n >= 1 steps is (3*n^2 + 5*n + c_r)/3, where r = n mod 3 and (c_0,c_1,c_2) = (0,4,2). A strip-clipped hexagon describes every collinear seed length, and becomes an unclipped hexagon at the sharp threshold n >= max(2,m-3) for m seeds and n >= 2. Its counts prove the three- and four-seed formulas recorded by Markey and the conjectured five-seed difference relation observed by Pfoertner and recorded by Markey. Corollaries give the periodic second differences and the precise series identities linking Barker's circle-addition and petal generating functions.

authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

work.title: Shannon's circle-vertex conjecture and the Markey–Pfoertner seed-growth relation: an expanding-hexagon proof
